test.template: Run the full pytest suite with timeout, excluding test_security.py. Show failures if any.

lint.template: Run ruff check on the full project and show any errors or warnings that need fixing.

backup.template: Create a full backup of all CATEYE data using `python run.py --backup` and report the result.

health.template: Check system health via /api/health endpoint and report the status, uptime, and any issues.

status.template: Show a full system status summary: health score, findings (total/confirmed/pending), active targets, reports this month, and background services status.
